task.description:
Update documentation to mark EE-07 as RELEASED and run the WF-02 retrospective.

1. Update `docs/status/requirement_status.json`:
   - Set EE-07 status to 'RELEASED'
   - Set released_at to current UTC timestamp
   - Set release_run to 'WF02-ee07-20260522'
   - Add implemented_in, test_spec, test_run, tested_at fields

2. Update `CHANGELOG.md`:
   - Add an entry for EE-07 under the current date section
   - Include: requirement ID, title ('Parallel gateway (join)'), key behaviours (join waits for all active tokens, cancelled branches excluded, all-cancelled → CANCELLED instance)

3. Run the WF-02 retrospective per `docs/agents/metrics.md §6`:
   - Read `handoffs/WF02-ee07-20260522/estimation.json`
   - Compute actual work time per step from started_at/completed_at fields in each step handoff
   - Compare estimated vs actual, compute variance_pct per step and overall
   - If |variance_pct| > 25% for any step: check whether to adjust `docs/metrics/estimation_rules.json`
   - Write `docs/metrics/retrospectives/WF02-ee07-20260522.json`

4. Update `handoffs/registry.json` to mark all WF02-ee07-20260522 entries as COMPLETED (they should already be COMPLETED from prior steps; verify and fix any that are not).
acceptance_criteria: docs/status/requirement_status.json: EE-07 status = RELEASED with released_at and release_run set

estimation_rules.json updated if any step variance > 25% across runs
All WF02-ee07-20260522 handoff entries in registry.json have status COMPLETED
